member.name: T:api_proj.Auth.ClaimsPrincipalExtensions
member.summary: Small helpers for reading the logged-in user's ID and role from their authentication cookie's claims (set at sign-in in AuthController). [Authorize] / [Authorize(Roles = "...")] on controllers/actions already handles "must be logged in" and "must have this role" - these helpers are for the extra ownership checks the Build Guide's Part AB/AE/AF/AG call for (e.g. confirming the logged-in Organiser owns the event they're trying to edit), which [Authorize] alone can't express.

member.name: M:api_proj.Auth.ClaimsPrincipalExtensions.GetUserId(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext)
member.summary: Returns the logged-in user's ID from their claims, or null if not authenticated.

member.name: M:api_proj.Auth.ClaimsPrincipalExtensions.GetRole(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.HttpContext)
member.summary: Returns the logged-in user's role from their claims, or null if not authenticated.
